# Notebooks

```{r notebooks, results="asis", echo=FALSE}
src <- list.files(here::here("reports/writeups/calibration_experiments"), pattern = "^e[0-9]+_.*[.]Rmd$", full.names = TRUE)
out_dir <- here::here("reports/calibration_experiments")
for (f in src) {
  html <- sub("[.]Rmd$", ".html", basename(f))
  title <- rmarkdown::yaml_front_matter(f)$title
  rendered <- file.exists(file.path(out_dir, html))
  stamp <- if (rendered) format(file.mtime(file.path(out_dir, html)), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") else "not rendered"
  cat(sprintf("- %s (%s)\n", if (rendered) sprintf("[%s](%s)", title, html) else title, stamp))
}
```
